facts.fact: The CNRC portal lets entrepreneurs create a company online without visiting the administrations, with a single registration to all of them.
The CNRC says the single registration gives the firm a common identification number, issued within three days of approval by CNRC, the tax directorate (DGI), CNAS, CASNOS and ONS.
The CNRC says the company-creation portal gives access to an electronic exchange platform between CNRC, the tax directorate (DGI), CNAS, CASNOS and ONS.
